Open your eyes to what they are really staging behind the scenes. They are playing us with this whole performance about South African actress Terry Pheto being "drawn into controversy," but it is just a convenient script designed to distract us from the real puppet masters. The establishment is actively parading this exact narrative right through Parliament, pushing it during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026.

They are desperately trying to make us buy the official line that this is merely an accidental slip involving the R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe. Do not fall for it. Every single official investigation and leaked detail is nothing more than a carefully staged distraction managed by the hidden elites to control the flow of capital and keep us pointing fingers at the actors while they pull the strings behind the curtain. The official story is always the exact inversion of the truth.
